content:
Kai: Quick thought  30-min Smash quickfire during lunch tomorrow? Casual brackets, rotate controllers, prizes = bragging rights + leftover donuts. @here :smiley:
Rina: Im in if there's a dock. My Switch is handheld only atm.
Omar: I can bring the dock + HDMI. Will need a small table for the setup.
Bea: Ill do bracket management. Single-elim, 8-player max?
Tess: 8 sounds good. Also suggest 2-minute rounds so we can get through more matches.
Kai: 2-min rounds + item toggle? I vote items off for fairness.
Rina: Items off, Omega stages excluded. 3-stock?
Bea: For quickfire, 1 stock + best-of-3 in finals? Keeps event short.
Omar: Ill bring a power strip and a spare Pro controller. Also will stream to #random for remote folks.
Tess: I'll snag the whiteboard and sticky notes for signups. Bring chargers folks.
event-bot: Event created: "Lunch Smash Quickfire" Tue 12:30  mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/lunch-smash-quickfire
Kai: Sweet. First 8 to sign up on the board get in, others do spectator rotation. See you tomorrow :fire:
